Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The upstream clone at f22af60d3683fdc4ffecf49ccff179fbc6750748 was not modified. The card's decision and helper (family-config, GymnasiumDriver) were used; the card's preferred upstream simulator was not run because it needs MuJoCo 1.50, mujoco-py, a C compiler and a MuJoCo licence key (README.md:7-10) and none is installed, so fake.py is a pure-Python analytic F0 stand-in and was not compared with the upstream environment. The upstream class is legacy gym: reset(shape_keys, hand_orientation) (kinova_gripper_env.py:1310) and step returns a four-tuple (:1552); the fake implements the gymnasium reset(seed, options)/five-tuple surface the bridge calls and carries the two required legacy arguments in reset options. NOT COVERED: the upstream 82-element local observation (kinova_gripper_env.py:440-454) and its rangefinder, joint, gravity and dot-product sensor values, the contact and grasp physics, the grasp classifier, and the object/shape coordinate files; the fake returns the 48-element observation declared by observation_space (:211-237) with placeholder poses, sizes and finger distances. The 30-step class attribute and the 100-step gym registration are not enforced as a time limit; done comes only from the lift rule (:661-663). Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset, so there is no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs (the seed input of cap.world.reset.v1, the seed input of cap.world.seed.v1, and action.values and ticks of cap.world.step.v1); the Gymnasium exemplar documents the same warnings. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 (all R0) are used, the mode is simulated with no hardware backend, and there are no catalogue requests, operator-required limits or site-limits.example.json. timestep_ms 150.0 is frame_skip 15 (kinova_gripper_env.py:51) times the model timestep 0.01 s (j2s7s300_end_effector_v1_mbox.xml:10). gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
